name: totalreclaw
description: End-to-end encrypted memory for Claude. Your memories are encrypted on this computer with a key only you hold, then stored across a decentralized network.
long_description: TotalReclaw gives Claude a private, portable memory. Facts, preferences and decisions are encrypted on your computer before they leave it, so the server only ever sees ciphertext. Set up once with a recovery phrase you generate in your browser (never in chat), and the same memory follows you across Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP apps on this machine.

server_url.title: Server URL (advanced)
server_url.description: Leave empty unless you run your own TotalReclaw server
